description: This class defines a Swing-based UI panel (SensorSnifferPane) that displays a real-time sensor data chart. It manages data collection from a central sensor listener, processes and plots the values, and provides controls for pausing, clearing, and saving the chart display. It also integrates with external UI components and handles user interactions.

classes.name: SensorSnifferPane
classes.description: A Swing panel for visualizing real-time sensor data as a line chart, with controls for pausing, clearing, and saving the display.

methods.name: SensorSnifferPane
methods.description: Constructor initializing the sensor sniffer panel, setting up listeners, UI components, and controls.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Sets the paused state of the chart updates and updates the pause button label.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the data drawn on the chart and resets data bounds.

methods.name: processValues
methods.description: Calculates the X and Y axis ranges based on current data points.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing the entire SensorSnifferPane UI.

methods.name: getTabSelectedListener
methods.description: Returns an ActionListener that requests focus on the command input when the tab is selected.
